title: Endpoint Disk Pressure Remediation

signals.name: Low free disk
signals.rationale: Low free disk is a direct cause of write failures and application instability.

signals.name: Application write failures
signals.rationale: Write failures align with disk pressure and should be validated before escalating as an application defect.

signals.name: Recurring temp growth
signals.rationale: Recurring temporary file growth suggests a cleanup plus problem management path.

baselines.name: Free disk space
baselines.rationale: Workstations below 15 percent free disk should be reviewed. Below 10 percent is commonly actionable.

baselines.name: Temp growth rate
baselines.rationale: Fast recurring temp growth can signal a repeatable endpoint hygiene issue.

baselines.name: App write failures
baselines.rationale: Sustained write failures above this range support endpoint remediation before app escalation.

baselines.name: Last reboot age
baselines.rationale: Long uptime can add risk when the endpoint is already showing application failures.

recommended_actions: Capture before state for free disk and application error.
Clean only approved cache and temp locations.
Validate the user workflow after cleanup.
Flag recurring growth for problem review.
escalation_template: Route to Endpoint Operations with disk report, application write error, before and after values, and recurrence notes.
